payload.description: Six fgOS agent definitions in core/agents (planner, debugger, code-reviewer, researcher, docs-manager, fullstack-developer) share their names with AgentKit's agents in .claude/agents/<name>.md, which AgentKit installs and fgOS no longer tracks (378f913ea). Two effects, seen on design-lap 2026-11-22: (1) node scripts/project-agents.mjs refuses the whole projection, 'core/agents/code-reviewer.yaml: refusing to overwrite .claude/agents/code-reviewer.md, which this script did not generate', and since it writes nothing when any file is refused, the 8 fgOS agents that are tracked cannot be re-projected either; (2) in Claude Code the agent type 'planner' (an fgOS head role that writes plans from a settled discussion) and the other five resolve to AgentKit's definitions, not fgOS's. AgentKit is someone else's project, so the fix is on the fgOS side: give the six fgOS agents names that cannot collide (or a project prefix), move every caller (core/agents, head grants, dispatch config, skills naming these agent types), and decide whether projection should skip a foreign file instead of refusing the whole run.
